messages.subject: Customising tick labels
parts:
Dear Group members,

I want to have the starting value 0 in X or Y axis replaced with some string specifying the unit of the series such as %, Million tonnes, $ etc ,  so that I don't have to specify the unit in the Axis label. I found I can do it this way with discrete numbers.
scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("0", "25", "50","75"),labels=c("%", "25", "50","75")).

But it doesn't work with continuous variables.

A short cut asking to replace 0 with the desired unit would be better rather than specifying all tick labels. For example, I can do this in Excel by specifying "[<>]General;%" to replace 0 with %

 Appreciate, if some one can help me.

Thank you very much in advance.

Ahmed Hafi
